stories.headline: Saquon's Stinger Scare Is Behind Him - Full Steam Ahead for Chicago
stories.read: Well pardner, Saquon took a jolt to the shoulder against Tennessee, but the doc's report came back clean and he rode through a full practice Friday. He's strappin' on some extra hide around that neck and shoulder for Monday's ride into Chicago, and by his own words he's feelin' good. That's your RB1 clear to ride with total confidence, no hedgin' needed - lock him into the lineup and don't look back.

stories.headline: Zay Flowers Testin' a Tender Hamstring - Pitch Count Comin' If He Rides
stories.read: Zay Flowers is fixin' to test that hamstring before Sunday's showdown with the Cowboys, and word from the wire says if he does saddle up, he'll be rationed out on a snap count. That's a soft flag for anybody startin' him outright - treat him as a flex play at best 'til he proves he can go full speed. Meanwhile keep an eye on the rest of that Ravens receivin' corps, 'cause a limited Flowers means somebody else pans a little extra gold on Sunday.

stories.headline: Jonah Coleman Strikes Gold in Denver's Busted-Up Backfield
stories.read: Both J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey are nursin' busted wheels in Denver, and rookie Jonah Coleman rode into that vacuum and struck paydirt in relief. He's now the number-one name on the open range this week, and there's real talk he simply takes the job and rides off with it. If he's still sittin' unclaimed in your outfit's league, stake your claim today, pardner - this diamond won't stay in the rough for long.
